name: go-workflows-durable-cancellation-policies-1c60
instr:
go-workflows cannot assign per-operation cancellation policies and handles to scheduled activities, timers, and subworkflows. Add independent abandon, request, and wait behavior. Return an idempotent cancellation handle with a stable completion future. Fresh execution and replay must produce the same observable outcome without changing established semantics, context cancellation, or uncanceled workflows.

Context and handle cancellation must converge on one operation-specific transition without duplicate durable events or results. Durably correlate committed activity cancellation to its scheduling identifier and preserve it through serialization. On replay, accept it only when command kind, identifier, and state match. Keep repeated requests, duplicate records, late completions, and mismatched records deterministic. Retain correlation through each policy's terminal boundary; commands and futures stop being observable there.

Distinguish activity cancellation before scheduling from cancellation after commitment, including immediate abandonment and pending requested cancellation. Keep timer-specific cancellation behavior. `TimerOptionCancellationPolicy` and `WithTimerCancellationPolicy` select request and wait policies. Subworkflow cancellation targets the child, while its policy controls parent-side completion. Stop activity and subworkflow retries at the policy boundary without changing ordinary failure retries. Cancellation futures use deterministic `Select` ordering like ot
